clauses.clause: Underground readability: player contrast ≥ 3:1; infected eyes brightest pixels.
clauses.note: Both actual low/high render tiers: authored l6-tunnel-retreat at110/15, production second-breach emergency state and actually collected headlamp. Original first-breach actor62 (npc.civilian-elderly) has ten resolved eye pixels; maximum eye relative luminance is0.24487004 low /0.23464440 high, below forehead pixel(772,384), RGB175/125/98, luminance0.24663033 at both tiers. The forehead is0.719% brighter at low and5.108% brighter at high. This strict numeric counterexample is not a large subjective visibility failure. Forehead is9.055px from the closest eye, beyond a2px excluded eye-edge margin. Every masked body pixel is bitwise identical in an independent repeated native PNG after restoring all probe materials at both tiers. Courier-maskP90 against actual2m ground ring exceeds3:1 (both .02 and .05 offsets reported). A different actual runner57 passes the eye comparison; the occluded shelter actor is explicitly inconclusive. Production instance-slot masks preserve source pose/mask nodes and keep other geometry depth-tested. Earlier infectedIdPass omitted NPC-skinned actors and was rejected, not repaired in game source. The measured forehead counterexample closes FAIL; all other looks/poses, the full shelter eye clause and a full route are not promoted to PASS.
